ordered_item: (2) conditional comparable re-measure of the named frozen family

reused_rule_source.rule: member-for-member regeneration of the named 15-member family under the frozen role-match rule (11 offline/rent-default + 4 server/served)
reused_rule_source.note: This gate does not re-derive the rule and does not re-score D1-D4 content.

zero_delta_check.meaning: The current product fixed-path bytes are the same bytes accepted run 40258497460 already measured; re-running the D1-D4 falsifier on them is zero-delta.

role_cardinality.ceiling_reason: server/served current=3 < frozen required=4, so at most 14/15 frozen members can match under the frozen role rule

adjudication.reason: Both (a) the current product fixed-path family is byte-identical to the family already measured by accepted run 40258497460 (49/49 named-family and 50/50 measured bundles), so a re-measure is zero-delta, and (b) the named family's role cardinality is not regenerated (server/served 3 vs 4; offline/rent-default 18 vs 11), so member-for-member matching is capped at 14/15. No synthetic stand-in is substituted.

claim_ceiling: Set/byte identity and role cardinality against already-accepted artifacts only; no new content-quality score, no new retrieval run, no universal-174k benchmark.
